notes.title: Trials on Tatooine 1.1 Update
notes.notes:
An update has been released for Trials on Tatooine!

We've added a hotkey for swapping which of the Vive controllers appears as the inactive controller inside the experience. Press Ctrl+H to swap the active and inactive controllers.

So if you find yourself in Trials on Tatooine and the controller you're holding appears blue and transparent, use Ctrl+H to swap it. No more having to physically swap controllers.
